thread:
zoe: Heads-up: after yesterday's RBAC cleanup we started seeing SAST runs fail because the test fixtures cannot be decrypted. error shows cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt denied for serviceAccount:ci-keystore@redwood-prod. noticed a flood of unrelated SAST findings too. anyone change keystore perms? :worried:

marcel: that was me. PR 5205 removed a project-level encrypter/decrypter binding for ci-keystore to follow least-priv. I didn't realize some runners impersonate that SA for fixture fetches. I can revert if that's fastest.

tara: sample error from the scanner: "KMS decrypt failed: PermissionDenied for serviceAccount:ci-keystore@redwood-prod". Scanner treats missing fixtures as source errors and we get a noisy run. Can we gate triage until infra is fixed?

sec-bot: Incident created: SEC-2026-IMP-3300001111. Owner: marcel. Evidence retention set to 14d.

oncall-sre: first step, confirm audit logs for decrypt attempts: run: gcloud logging read "protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"serviceAccount:ci-keystore@redwood-prod\" AND protoPayload.methodName:kms.*Decrypt" --limit=50 --format=json
If DENIED entries exist -> revert. If no entries -> logging ingestion issue.

marcel: reverting now, will regrant roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter with a 30m TTL annotation and open a follow-up to scope properly. DRAFT PR 5210.

oncall-sre: applied revert. audit logs show DENIED at 02:59 and SUCCESS at 03:03 after revert. New SAST run shows fixtures decrypted and false findings drop.

zoe: mitigation good. follow-ups: - Add pre-merge checklist item for any change touching cloudkms resources to run `infra-smoke/kms-decrypt` and include the log-query output in PR description. - Prefer granting specific key-level bindings instead of project-wide. - Add an "infra:outage:<incident-id>" label to SAST runs so triage can filter.

tara: SecOps can you apply the label to the affected runs so triage doesn't waste cycles? we still need the evidence retained though.

infra-bot: Label infra:outage:SEC-2026-IMP-3300001111 applied to runs. Evidence retention=14d.

marcel: I'll update PR 5210 to include TTL and an Impact Statement. I'll also add an example of impersonation pattern that avoids granting decrypt at project scope.

oncall-sre: I'll file INFRA-204 to add the infra-smoke preflight job that triggers when terraform diffs include "cloudkms" resources. Also recommend an alert on >2 PERMISSION_DENIED kms decrypts for any keystore SA in 5m.

zoe: I'll draft a short SDLC checklist PR that requires the log-query and smoke test for KMS RBAC changes, and add a template snippet for TTL grants. Assigning to tara for review.

marcel: thanks, reverting resolved the immediate noise. will follow up on the scoped grant plan.
